newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt trade says sunflower oil purchase 28,500 T.
newsitem.headline: Egypt trade says sunflower oil purchase 28,500 T.

text.p: Cairo-based traders said on Wednesday Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries bought 28,500 tonnes of sunflower oil at $560 per tonne for delivery in the second half of August.
The traders said Egypt had bought the oil from Swiss firm Andre.
Earlier, London traders said Egypt had bought 28,000 tonnes of sunflower oil at $560.50 a tonne c and f.
The Cairo traders added that Egypt had scrapped its tenders for cottonseed oil and soybean oil due to high prices.
The holding firm had originally tendered for 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes of cottonseed, sunflower and soybean oils for delivery in August. --Cairo newsroom +202 578b 3290/1
